home.title: IP3 Consulting | Policy, Economics & International Development Advisory
home.desc: IP3 Consulting helps multilateral institutions, development partners, governments, businesses and research institutions design policies, prepare investments, strengthen institutions and measure development impact.

about.title: About IP3 Consulting — Institute for Public Policy & Practice
about.desc: IP3 is a next-generation think tank, an Action Research and Management Consulting firm founded in 2018, combining systems thinking, data and digital ecosystems, and translational research to turn evidence into measurable impact.
about.h1: A strategic policy analysis, action research & management solutions firm for an equitable, resilient, and sustainable future.
about.lead: The Institute for Public Policy and Practice works at the intersection of policy research, strategic advisory, management solutions and implementation.

why.title: Why choose IP3
why.desc: From polycrisis to polysolution: how IP3 connects systems, evidence, policy and practice, shown as a scroll-driven 3D journey with capabilities, sectors and work.
why.lead: IP3 turns complex development challenges into evidence, policy, and practical action.

approach.title: Our Approach — From Policy to Implementation
approach.desc: IP3’s pathway from evidence to delivery: sense and diagnose, build intelligence, co-design and test, mobilise, implement and transfer, learn and scale.
approach.h1: Reform is a movement, not a moment.
approach.lead: Complex challenges rarely fail for want of another recommendation. They fail when evidence is disconnected from decisions, strategy from financing, technology from users, and reform from the institutions that must own it.

capabilities.title: Feasibility, Policy & Climate Finance Consulting
capabilities.desc: Development consulting in Bangladesh: feasibility studies, policy and economic advisory, climate finance, MEL and surveys, with 37 documented assignments.
capabilities.lead: IP3 Consulting supports development partners, government institutions and investors with feasibility studies, policy and economic advisory, climate-finance project preparation, baseline surveys and evaluation, institutional reform, and responsible digital transformation. Explore our capabilities and selected assignments to identify the evidence, design or implementation support your project needs.

sectors.title: Sectors
sectors.desc: Eight connected sectors: climate and energy, education and skills, health and social protection, digital government, governance and public finance, economic transformation, sustainable finance and ESG, and AI for public systems.
sectors.lead: IP3 works across eight interconnected sectors where economic, institutional, environmental and technological risks overlap. We combine specialist sector knowledge with cross-cutting capabilities in economics, finance, governance, data and implementation.

engagements.title: Selected Engagements
engagements.desc: Selected IP3 engagements with ADB, the World Bank, SIDA/CPD, the Ministry of Finance and BMDF: feasibility studies, surveys, institutional transformation and climate-resilience finance.
engagements.h1: The challenge. Our mandate. What we delivered.
engagements.lead: Recent engagements and impact projects with global development partners and national ministries. Results are shared with client permission; references are available on request.

insights.title: Evidence & Insights
insights.desc: Research and analysis from IP3: green financial product design, data-driven learning outcomes, Bangladesh’s ESG transition and municipal finance transformation.
insights.lead: Thinking that ships — how institutions diagnose, finance and deliver. Decision-ready diagnostics, business cases and evaluations, not publications for their own sake.

people.title: IP3 People
people.desc: Meet IP3’s leadership, advisors, founding directors, deputy directors, affiliated research scholars and support units.
people.lead: A dynamic network of economists and thinkers from a range of disciplines who understand the intricate balance between prosperity and the planet.

contact.title: Contact
contact.desc: Contact IP3 Consulting Limited in Dhaka — discuss a consulting assignment, a partnership, a research collaboration, or request our capability statement.
contact.h1: Tell us the mandate you need to deliver.
contact.lead: Use the form to prepare an email draft, then send it from your email app. You can also call or email us directly.

finder.title: Mandate Finder
finder.desc: Match your sector and the kind of help you need to IP3's relevant capabilities, engagements and published insights, then start a conversation.
finder.lead: Two short questions connect your challenge to IP3's relevant work. It is anonymous: nothing you choose is saved or sent.
